remaining_gaps: Clause EO:11262#sec1-item4-level-IV: actual termination date of the President's Commission on Law Enforcement and Administration of Justice not held. EO 11236 sec. 8 gives only a deadline (final report within 18 months of 1965-07-23; terminate not later than 90 days after presenting it); no held source gives the report date or the termination. EO 11409 item 1(b) (1968-04-29) is only an upper bound for this standing placement.

Clause EO:11293#sec2-item8-level-V and whole_order_end: whether the Interior position Commissioner, Federal Water Pollution Control Administration, ended with the 1970 renaming/transfer or continued under the EO 11587 retitling until the EO 11604 deletion (1971-07-02) cannot be decided. Neither the Water Quality Improvement Act of 1970 (Pub. L. 91-224) nor Reorganization Plan No. 3 of 1970 is held, so a statutory abolition date cannot be cited.

Clause EO:11299 (Director, Urban Transportation Administration, HUD): no held source shows whether the HUD Urban Transportation Administration and its Director post ended with Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1968 (transfer of urban mass transportation functions to the Department of Transportation) or still existed when EO 11634 deleted the item on 1971-12-06. The Plan text and a HUD organization record are not held; the deletion is only an upper bound. Also the kit inventory (30 segmented scopes) differs from the codif single-clause inventory and would need inventory overrides if the order were submitted.

Clause EO:11367#adds-assistant-director-executive-management-bob-level-iv: EO 11540 (effective 1970-07-01) substitutes 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget' in item (5); EO 11708 sec. 3 revokes EO 11248 as amended on 1973-03-23. Whether the 1970 substitution ended the placement (broader generic OMB office) or only retitled the same position, so that it ran to 1973, depends on Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1970 and on OMB organization facts (did an Assistant Director for Executive Management continue?), neither held. Both candidate dates are retitling/revocation events, not a source-backed end.

Clause EO:11409#item1c-level-IV-item9: the date the Cabinet Committee on Price Stability (and its Executive Director position) was discontinued is not held; EO 11468 item 1 (1969-05-10) is only an upper bound. No establishing or discontinuing document for the committee is in the repository.

Clause EO:11468#item2-level-V-item23: Deputy Assistant Postmaster General, Bureau of Operations, Post Office Department. The Postal Reorganization Act (Pub. L. 91-375) text and commencement/abolition provisions are not held (only later EOs that mention the Act), so the date the position ended by statute is not citable; EO 11634 item 2(a) (1971-12-06) is only an upper bound, and the gap between the Postal Service start and that deletion is unexplained.

Clause EO:11499#sec2-item21-level-V and whole_order_end: no held GSA order or organization record shows when the Transportation and Communications Service (and its Commissioner post) was abolished or reorganized. If before 1973-03-23 that date is the first end; otherwise EO 11708 sec. 3 (1973-03-23, which does not list this post in sec. 2) would be. EO 11708 is only an upper bound until the GSA record is held.

EO:10440#sec2: date the Civil Service Commission completed the reclassification directed by sec. 2 (the original continues the Schedule A and B listings 'until the Commission has taken action with respect to such positions under this order'). This is a performed/spent transitional command, so it needs the completion date from a held source; none is held (no Commission Federal Register notice of the Schedule A/B/C classification and no FY1953 annual report). EO 10577 effective 1955-01-23 is only an upper bound.
